title: RosmarOps Observatory: daily raw collection (raw.v1)
description: What observatory/collect.py read from the fixed sources F1-F62 on one day (GTM-75). Data from public sources only; no prose of ours.

date.description: Day of the collection in Madrid.

total.description: 28 until GTM-77, 29 with F29 Muse Code, then F30 and F31 (n8n, GTM-86), F32-F36 (TRAE, Qwen Code, Kimi Code, CodeBuddy, Qoder CN; GTM-93), and F37-F43 (Aider, OpenHands, Amp, Warp, Junie, Kilo Code, Comet; GTM-98) and F44 (Grok Build; GTM-99), F45 (Grok Bot; GTM-159), F46 and F47 (watch of Grok Bot read access; GTM-160), F48-F61 (watch of the sandbox templates' pages; GTM-175) and F62 (Claude Code settings reference, second page of its template; 17-11).

date_is_detection.description: true when latest_date and the dates in new are the day the collector first saw the version, not a publication date (GTM-77).

watched.description: page-watch sources only (GTM-160): today's lines and links that mention Grok Bot with read, rules, settings, connectors, OAuth or scope.

missing.description: page-watch sources of a sandbox template only (GTM-175): the watch strings no longer in the page. Empty when all are there.
